An '''exploration probe vessel''' dispatched by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] returned during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and was covered in a purple slime. The substance was identified as the secretions of a [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]]-like spaceborne creature.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Shipborne Parasite}}</ref>
